_about: Translator context for every key in ui/menu.ui.i18n.json (JSON cannot carry comments). Key format: namespace:region.screen.purpose. A unit test requires one entry per key.
terms:game.title: Game title. EN fixed: White Myth: Nezha.
terms:hero.nezha: Player character name, pinyin. Never translate.
terms:place.dragonPalace: The crystal palace under the East Sea (setting).
terms:weapon.spear: Nezha's spear; 2.4 m, fire at the tip.
terms:weapon.wheels: Flaming wheels under Nezha's feet; he always hovers on them.
terms:weapon.sash: Nezha's red silk sash (混天绫). EN: Red Armillary Sash.
terms:boss.dragonKing: Boss name, title-card form. HUD and subtitle forms differ (see spec section 8).
ui:menu.common.language: Accessible label of the 中文 / EN toggle group.
ui:menu.start.title: Start screen heading; references the game title term.
ui:menu.start.kicker: Small overline above the title: the location.
ui:menu.start.subtitle: One-sentence premise under the title. Max ~2 lines at 1280x600.
ui:menu.start.begin: Primary button that starts play. Keep short (button).
ui:menu.start.milestone: Build tag shown on the start screen during playtests.
ui:menu.pause.title: Pause screen heading.
ui:menu.pause.hint: Explains that clicking the game also resumes.
ui:menu.controls.title: Heading of the controls list.
ui:menu.controls.move: WASD action: hovering movement (Nezha never walks).
ui:menu.controls.lock: R action: lock on to / release the target.
ui:menu.controls.soon: Tag on controls that are not playable yet.
ui:menu.controls.keyMouse: Key cap text for the mouse.
ui:menu.controls.keyLmb: Key cap text for the left mouse button.
ui:hud.hint.noTarget: Toast when R finds nothing within 25 m. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.targetLost: Toast when the lock breaks beyond 30 m. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.locked: Toast when lock-on succeeds. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.unlocked: Toast when the player releases the lock. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.tip.clickToLook: Top tip while playing without pointer lock.
terms:item.lotus: Healing item from Taiyi Zhenren; 3 per fight. EN plural form used as the item name.
terms:skill.sashBind: Skill: the sash binds the enemy for 3 s. EN fixed: Sash Bind.
terms:skill.roll: Evasive roll on the Wind-Fire Wheels (Space). EN fixed: Wind-Fire Roll.
ui:menu.controls.roll: Space: dodge roll toward the move direction, backwards with no direction.
ui:menu.controls.lightAttack: Left mouse: light attack, up to 3 hits.
ui:menu.controls.heavyAttack: Right mouse: hold to charge, release to strike.
ui:menu.controls.lotus: Q: eat a lotus seed to heal.
ui:menu.controls.sash: 1: Sash Bind, holds the target still.
ui:menu.controls.keyRmb: Key cap text for the right mouse button.
ui:menu.controls.keySpace: Key cap text for the space bar.
ui:hud.hint.noStamina: Toast when an action needs more stamina. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.noLotusSeeds: Toast when Q is pressed with no seeds left. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.sashCooldown: Toast when Sash Bind is used during its cooldown. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.yakshaWave1: Toast when the first wave of sea yaksha (sea demons with tridents) ambushes Nezha on the boardwalk. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.yakshaWave2: Toast when the second, larger yaksha wave blocks the boardwalk. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.gateOpen: Toast when all yaksha are defeated and the Sea-Calming Water Gate opens. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.checkpoint: Toast when Nezha passes the Taiyi Lotus shrine (respawn point on the boardwalk). Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.bar.hp: Label of the player health bar. HUD budget 22 chars.
ui:hud.bar.stamina: Label of the player stamina bar. HUD budget 22 chars.
ui:hud.banner.defeat: Defeat banner shown for 1 s in the middle of the screen when Nezha's health reaches zero; then the fight restarts. Chinese is a single calligraphic character「败」; keep it one short word.
terms:boss.dragonKingHud: Boss name on the HUD health bar (top centre). HUD budget 22 chars (spec §8: HUD form).
terms:boss.dragonKingSpeaker: Speaker name above the Dragon King's subtitle lines (spec §8: subtitle speaker form).
terms:item.reverseScale: Reward shown on the result screen: a scale from under the dragon's throat. Display only (no game use).
ui:menu.pause.restart: Pause menu button: restart the fight from the fishing lamp (skips the intro). Button budget 16 chars.
ui:menu.pause.toTitle: Pause menu button: back to the start screen. Button budget 16 chars.
ui:menu.pause.time: Pause menu label before the run timer (e.g. "Time 1:23.4").
ui:menu.controls.skip: Controls list: Enter skips the intro and confirms Try Again.
ui:dialogue.dragonKing.intro: Intro line, the Dragon King to Nezha, cold and weary; he has waited years. Two lines (\n), ≤ 42 chars each. Shown 288 steps.
ui:dialogue.nezha.intro: Intro line, Nezha answering the Dragon King: a curt ultimatum (the flood drowning Chentang Pass). Two lines, ≤ 42 chars each.
ui:dialogue.dragonKing.phase2: Phase-change line, the Dragon King: Nezha cut out his own flesh and bones to repay his father Li Jing; "my son" is Ao Bing — do NOT add his name. Two lines, ≤ 42 chars each.
ui:dialogue.nezha.phase2: Phase-change reply, Nezha: his life was already repaid; the people of Chentang Pass owe nothing. Two lines, ≤ 42 chars each.
ui:dialogue.dragonKing.defeat: The Dragon King when Nezha falls (first time per session). Nezha was reborn from a lotus. One line ≤ 42 chars.
ui:dialogue.dragonKing.fall: The Dragon King's last words as he falls. "My son" is Ao Bing — do not name him. The emotional low point; keep it quiet. ≤ 42 chars.
ui:dialogue.nezha.victory: Nezha after the Dragon King falls; restrained, not triumphant. ≤ 42 chars.
ui:hud.banner.retry: Defeat screen button under「败」: restart the fight at once (Enter also works). Button budget 16 chars.
ui:hud.tip.skip: Intro corner prompt next to the Enter key cap: skip the intro. ≤ 12 chars.
ui:result.title.main: Result screen title after the Dragon King falls: the tide (his flood) settles. Title form.
ui:result.stat.hits: Result label: number of attacks that hurt Nezha.
ui:result.stat.perfect: Result label: number of perfect dodges.
ui:result.stat.rating: Result label before the S / A / B letter.
ui:result.reward.label: Result screen: heading of the reward box.
ui:result.reward.desc: Flavour text of the Reverse Scale reward (a dragon is enraged if it is touched). Two lines, ≤ 42 chars each.
ui:result.action.retry: Result screen button: fight again (skips the intro). Button budget 16 chars.
ui:result.action.toTitle: Result screen button: back to the start screen. Button budget 16 chars.
ui:menu.controls.mute: Controls list: M toggles all game sound and music.
ui:hud.float.stamina: Floating text beside the stamina bar after a perfect dodge; {n} = stamina refunded (30). ≤ 12 chars.
ui:hud.float.staminaFull: Same floating text when stamina was already full. ≤ 14 chars.
ui:menu.controls.jump: Controls list: Ctrl / F jumps; a light attack in the air is a plunging strike.
